mcqs.question: Which wetland is noted for being protected by religious norms?
mcqs.explanation: Renuka Lake in Himachal Pradesh is protected by religious norms. Tso Kar is associated with Ladakh and is a high-altitude Ramsar site, while Bhoj Wetland is in Bhopal and Deepor Beel is in Assam.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding wetland-conservation initiatives and activities:

List-I
(a) Amrit Dharohar
(b) Mission Sahbhagita
(c) Wetland Mitras
(d) Training under Amrit Dharohar

List-II
(i) 18,000 persons
(ii) Livelihoods and eco-tourism
(iii) 2 million persons sensitised
(iv) ALP and Paryatan Navik Certificate

Choose the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iii, c-i and d-iv. Amrit Dharohar focused on livelihoods and eco-tourism; Mission Sahbhagita sensitised 2 million persons; there were 18,000 Wetland Mitras; and training included ALP and the Paryatan Navik Certificate. The other codes interchange these scheme details and achievements.
